thread:
maria_support: FYI customer ACME reporting repeated 5xx and spikes of 504s since 09:12 UTC during a traffic burst. They see timeouts for hosted inference requests. escalated ticket #98712
jamie_sre: Assigned. Quick question — is this single region? which model? any Dedicated customers pinned? :eyes:
maria_support: Hosted, us-west-2, using rwd-open-7b-v2. Not dedicated. Customer says errors start ~09:12 and last ~30-60s bursts. Sent logs: snippet below.
maria_support: ```
2026-03-17T09:12:23Z ERROR gateway: request failed tenant=acme status=504 proxy_ms=60000 route=/v1/generate
2026-03-17T09:12:23Z WARN provisioner: scale_up_duration=64s scaled_to=0->2
2026-03-17T09:12:23Z ERROR auth: token_exchange tenant=acme status=403 msg="service account rotated"
```
leila_eng: Interesting — token 403 during the same window could block preflight hooks (billing/auth fetch). If KEDA reads a metric that hits auth and it fails, scaledobject controller may not emit correct scale events. Could be cascade: auth -> failed warmup -> requests queue -> gateway 504.
jamie_sre: Pulling autoscaler logs. opsbot: @matt_oncall added to channel.
matt_oncall: I see KEDA event noise at 09:11: metrics-server timed out talking to billing-proxy. Also HPA shows desired=0 current=0 then jumps to desired=3 but pods not Ready for ~70s.
leila_eng: Can you paste the scaledobject and deployment annotations? suspect cooldown or misconfigured scaledownThreshold.
jamie_sre: ```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: acme-model-scaledobj
  annotations:
    autoscaling.keda.sh/active: "true"
spec:
  cooldownPeriod: 30
  pollingInterval: 2
  minReplicaCount: 0
  maxReplicaCount: 10
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      query: "sum(rate(model_queue_length[30s]))"
```
maria_support: Customer also attached model init logs — cold-start model fetch sometimes hits S3 timeouts and takes ~45s for weights.
customer_ops: Confirmed: model pull spikes coincide with errors. We saw repeated 5xx in their app logs and frontend 504s.
leila_eng: That adds up: minReplicaCount=0 + model pull ~45s + scale_up_duration ~60s = requests time out. Also auth 403s in same window made prewarm webhooks fail. We need to mitigate quickly for customer and fix config.
jamie_sre: Immediate mitigations: 1) bump minReplicaCount to 1 for this tenant pool, 2) add short burst prewarm (pre-warm annotation) and increase readiness timeout, 3) route heavy tenants to fallback smaller quantized model for now. I'll patch a canary.
matt_oncall: Doing step 1 now for tenant acme pool (kubectl patch). Will also add a temporary Route rule to fallback-model-quantized.
opsbot: matt_oncall set-minreplicas acme-model-deploy -> 1
matt_oncall: Patching scaledobject cooldown to 10 and minReplicaCount=1. Applying prewarm annotation: "redwood.io/prewarm=true"
leila_eng: Also found KEDA controller logs showing errors calling billing proxy: "GET /metrics -> 502 Bad Gateway" at 09:11:15 — that's the auth/billing interlock. We're opening infra ticket to investigate billing-proxy VPC egress flaps.
maria_support: Customer notified of workaround: increasing prewarm to avoid further timeouts. They've accepted temporary route to quantized model.
customer_ops: Thanks — errors dropped after the minReplica bump and fallback. We'll monitor and share logs if anything else shows up.
jamie_sre: Follow-ups: - infra to root-cause billing-proxy 502s and token rotate race - eng to add prewarm suggestion to Optimize for workloads with large model pulls - product: consider tenant-level minReplica guard for hosted SLAs
leila_eng: Repro steps we recorded:
1) Set tenant pool minReplicaCount=0 and remove prewarm annotation
2) Simulate a 3x QPS spike with payloads that trigger model fetch (cold cache)
3) Simultaneously rotate service account token for auth proxy (force 403s)
Observed: scale reaction time >60s, model init 40-50s, queued requests 30-60s -> 504s/gateway timeouts.
leila_eng: Logs for repro (abridged):
```
09:11:12 Request queue length=12 -> emit scale
09:11:13 KEDA poll -> metrics fetch error 502
09:11:15 HPA desired=3 but pods Pending
09:11:18 model-fetch s3 GET timeout 45s
09:12:23 gateway respond 504
```
jamie_sre: I'm creating incident runbook entries and a customer postmortem stub. tagging infra and product. assigning owners: infra (matt_oncall), eng-runtime (leila_eng), support (maria_support).
matt_oncall: Filed INF-2213 for billing-proxy egress flaps. I'll capture VPC flow logs and LB traces.
maria_support: I'll update ticket #98712 with timeline and mitigation notes. Customer asked for SLA credit assessment — forwarding to finance.
leila_eng: Long term: add autoscale prewarm heuristics for large-model tenants, recommend minReplica >=1 for production tenants with model weight >500MB, and add health-check that blocks scale-to-zero if auth fetch fails.
jamie_sre: Closing immediate incident, keeping channel open for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
